_comment: Every thyn-ai repository the toolchain manages, with its opengrep overlay and caller workflow.
workflow: full = security-full.yml (all four owner tools); smoke = security-smoke.yml (gitleaks + pins).
sync_safe_paths: for repositories mirrored from elsewhere, the only paths propagate may touch.
python: adds ruff hooks to a freshly generated .pre-commit-config.yaml (never to an existing one).
Set python:true ONLY where the repository already has a [tool.ruff] config it passes; a blocking ruff
hook on a never-linted tree stalls every commit (telys: 744 pre-existing violations).
An overlay selects Opengrep rule packs only. osv-scanner walks the whole tree and reads every lockfile
it supports (package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lock, uv.lock, pixi.lock, ...), and trivy
config and gitleaks take the whole tree too, so a repository's package manager never enters the choice.
python-javascript is the python+javascript pack set; pnpm-monorepo is the same set under its pre-0.1.12
name, kept as an alias for repositories already propagated with it (a caller's security.yml keeps the
overlay it was onboarded with; only the pin moves).
mojo-kernels: python-javascript -- Python wrappers + a Node/CJS wrapper under npm workspaces (python-uv
would skip the JS; engine/codna are reserved names). Its Mojo sources are excluded by the repo's own
.semgrepignore (*.mojo).
Excluded on purpose: decimas, decimas-site (empty); codna-app-smoke, codna-app-e2e-smoke-1783715773,
codna-private-test, test-codna-app-e2e (deliberately broken e2e fixtures).
dependabot_auto_merge (default true): render .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml, the caller that
enables auto-merge on Dependabot pull requests. Precondition, checked 2026-09-20 for every repository here:
the default branch requires the `codna review` status check -- the org ruleset 'Codna Review required'
(23610580) for the private repositories, a repository ruleset for the six public ones and the seven
Vercel sites' 'Deploy gate (main)'. Set false on a repository that drops that requirement.
dependabot_auto_merge_majors (default false): also let semver-major updates auto-merge; the rendered
caller's own `auto_merge_majors:` is preserved on later bumps, so flip it in the repository too.
The caller enables auto-merge only after codna's review is APPROVED with zero unresolved threads (its
check-run concludes neutral whenever it left an inline finding, and a neutral conclusion passes a
required check; rulesets with required_review_thread_resolution -- codna, algenta, cohenta, codna-site --
would otherwise hold an enabled auto-merge forever). Findings are never resolved by the workflow.
Up-to-date policy (strict_required_status_checks_policy), audited 2026-09-20: a merge turns the other
open Dependabot PRs BEHIND and Dependabot did not rebase them, so the policy is off on every private
repository (cohenta 17646026 and algenta 17410382 switched off that day). Public repositories keep it:
algenta-sdk behind its merge queue (which rebases), and algenta-integrations, mojo-kernels, codna-action,
feedback without one -- there a Dependabot PR lands on its own only while up to date, else after
`@dependabot rebase`; OpenSSF Scorecard's Branch-Protection check scores the policy, so it stays.
